messages:
elaine-partners: Heads up team — kickoff for cloud marketplace onboarding across AWS/GCP/Azure for the pilot. Need explicit owners for key material, metering mapping, EULA telemetry language, and packaging assets. Main constraints: EU data residency for keys, automated metering export, and trial enforcement.

elaine-partners: Quick checklist to confirm:
1) KMS/CMEK/KeyVault instances per region + access grants
2) SKU -> meter dimension mapping and export cadence
3) EULA trial & telemetry paragraph (opt-out path)
4) Packaging bundle (icons, 1-liner, long copy, screenshots)

jess-cloudops: I can coordinate KeyVault and the Azure access policy templates. We'll aim for a non-exportable key with RBAC assigned to the managed identity used by the marketplace ingestion service.

nik-infra: For GCP I'll create a CMEK in europe-west1 for EU customers and a global default in us-central1. Service account will be: marketplace-onboard@redwood-dev.iam.gserviceaccount.com

toby-aws-eng: AWS plan: create a KMS key per region (us-west-2, eu-west-1), with alias alias/marketplace/redwood. Cross-account policy will allow the partner deploy role + our ingestion role to use Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey. Example policy snippet I can post.

elaine-partners: Nick — please flag any limitations for CMEK usage with our deployment tooling. Also, confirm TTL/rotation cadence.

nik-infra: Rotation enabled by default, we can set 90 days. Caveat: some legacy images don't support CMEK at instance creation; we'll note that in the onboarding guide.

michael-product: SKU naming proposal: "redwood.standard", "redwood.dedicated", "redwood.private" and trials as suffix ".trial" e.g., redwood.standard.trial. Keep mapping simple for billing.

elaine-partners: Love the dot notation — easier to parse. Need mapping to marketplace dimensions, e.g.:
redwood.standard -> token_count
redwood.dedicated -> instance_hours
redwood.private -> instance_hours, support_units

jess-cloudops: Metering export plan: emit counters hourly to vendor metering API. We'll use a lambda (AWS) / cloud function (GCP) / function app (Azure) to push JSON with dimensions. Example payload: {"sku":"redwood.standard","timestamp":"...","token_count":1234} (we'll paste exact schema in the onboarding doc).

toby-aws-eng: Note: AWS marketplace requires usage reports within 1 hour of the metric window end. Our lambda should batch and retry on 5xx. Also we must sign requests with the vendor API key — Elaine, can you get that from partner portal?

elaine-partners: I'll request the metering endpoint and credentials today and drop them in this thread.

sara-legal: Draft EULA/telemetry blurb: "We collect aggregated, non-identifying usage and performance data to enable billing, optimize service quality, and detect abuse. Customers may disable non-essential telemetry via the account settings; disabling may affect trial features and support. Logs are retained 30 days, aggregated usage metrics 90 days. For EU customers, keys and logs are stored in-region unless otherwise agreed." Thoughts?

michael-product: Edited suggestion for UI wording: "Telemetry: anonymous usage metrics help with billing and quality. Opt-out available; may limit trial functionality." Short one-liner for marketplace tile: "Low-latency LLM inference — predictable cost and private deployment options."

nik-infra: Regarding trial enforcement: propose adding fields to the onboarding manifest: 
```
"trial_limits": {"period_days":"14","tokens_per_day":"5000","concurrent_deployments":"2"}
```
Gateway will reject requests that exceed daily token counters. We'll emit meter records even for trial usage.

jess-cloudops: For Azure KeyVault, we'll prepare an ARM template sample and include an access policy snippet that grants get/unwrapKey/wrapKey to the service principal.

ops-bot: MARKETING-789 created and linked: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/MARKET-789 - assignees: jess-cloudops, toby-aws-eng, sara-legal.

elaine-partners: Packaging assets needed: 1x 1024x1024 icon, 1x 512x512 logo, 3 screenshots (1280x720), short line (<= 120 chars), long description (150-250 words), feature bullet list. Michael — can you assemble drafts?

michael-product: I'll put together drafts and a storyboard for screenshots. Will share an assets bucket link.

toby-aws-eng: I'll upload the CFN snippets and the KMS cross-account policy by EOD. Sample policy excerpt I'll post here for review.

sara-legal: One more legal: include a sentence about breach notification timelines in the marketplace listing (we need ability to notify customers and vendors within 72 hours for security incidents).

elaine-partners: OK action owners summary:
- toby-aws-eng: AWS KMS + CloudFormation + metering lambda template (owner)
- nik-infra: GCP CMEK + service account + manifest fields for trial limits (owner)
- jess-cloudops: Azure KeyVault ARM samples + access policy (owner)
- sara-legal: Final EULA snippet + breach notification clause (owner)
- michael-product: Packaging copy + screenshots + asset bucket (owner)
- elaine-partners: request marketplace API key, handle vendor coordination (owner)

elaine-partners: Timeline: aim for all artifacts in the shared folder by next Wednesday so we can kick the vendor onboarding call Thursday. Ping here for blockers. :rocket:
